name: Enclomiphene citrate

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The trans isomer of clomiphene, a pure estrogen receptor antagonist without the accumulating agonist isomer. It was studied for secondary hypogonadism and was not approved; material in current use is supplied through compounding pharmacies rather than as an approved product. Investigated as Androxal and not approved. No FDA label exists for enclomiphene as a single agent.

systems.note: Blocks hypothalamic estrogen negative feedback, raising LH and endogenous testosterone; placed on the gonads by intended effect.
Oral SERM with class hepatic concern and no approved safety labelling.
Visual disturbance is described for the parent compound class.
